```text
# PR #3265: Patch: a phone highlights nothing but the chat

Closes #3260

## What changed

On a phone the web client now highlights nothing except the chat.

- **`apps/web/src/index.css`**
  - `html` takes `-webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent` at every pointer, since only touch browsers draw a tap flash.
  - Under `@media (pointer: coarse)`, `html` takes `user-select: none` and `-webkit-touch-callout: none`. Both prefixed and unprefixed `user-select` are set. A narrow desktop window still selects text.
  - In the same block, `input`, `textarea` and non-`false` `[contenteditable]` take `user-select: text` back. iOS will not type into or place a caret in a field that cannot be selected.
  - The new rules sit below the existing `html { cursor: … }` rule, which `cursors.test.ts` pins byte for byte.
- **`apps/web/src/together/together.css`**: `.chat-panel` restores the tap highlight (`initial`), the callout (`default`) and `user-select: text`. These are outside any media query.
- **`apps/web/src/game/board.css`**: the #2015 `.zone:not([data-legal="true"])` rules are removed. The tap highlight is inherited, so their `initial` on a zone's children brought the flash back on every card.
- **`apps/web/src/auth/two-step.css`**: the 2FA key gets `-webkit-user-select: all`. See "Decisions".
- **`apps/web/src/highlight.test.ts`** (new): 7 tests that read the stylesheets as text, since jsdom matches no media query. They cover each of the following:
  - `html` takes no tap highlight at any pointer.
  - `html` keeps selection at a fine pointer.
  - `html` takes no selection and no callout under a coarse pointer.
  - Fields take their text back.
  - `.chat-panel` restores all three.
  - No stylesheet but the chat's sets the tap highlight to anything but `transparent` or `inherit`, and `board.css` has no `initial`.
  - The 2FA key stays selectable.
- **`apps/web/src/game/Zone.test.tsx`**: the old #2015 CSS test and its three now-unused imports are removed, and the header points to `highlight.test.ts`. The two #2015 behaviour tests stay.
- **`apps/web/README.md`**: one paragraph, "A phone highlights nothing but the chat (#3260)".

No ruling note, `spec/pending` file or `R<n>` citation is needed: the issue sets a presentation rule, not a game rule.

## How it was tested

- **Targeted run.** `pnpm exec vitest run --project web` on `highlight.test.ts`, `Zone.test.tsx`, `palette`, `typescale`, `surfaces`, `motion`, `cursors` and `typography` printed 8 files and 56 tests passed.
- **Mutation check.** I put the four original stylesheets back, and all 7 new tests failed. I restored the new ones afterwards, and `git diff --stat` shows only the intended 6 files plus the new test.
- **Full web suite.** I ran it with the harness's excludes (`audio`, `fx` and `cards/art/convention.test.ts`): 456 files, 8283 tests passed, 1 skipped. The skip is not mine; I added none.
- **Typecheck, lint, format.** `pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck` and `eslint` on `highlight.test.ts` and `Zone.test.tsx` printed nothing. `cargo fmt --check` exited 0.
- **Not run.** `cargo jackioh classify --base origin/main --claims` (a release build of the tools, too slow here for a web-only CSS change), `spec check` (no ruling added or cited), and the Cargo, clippy and Rust test checks (no Rust touched). The harness runs its own set after this.
- **Phone check.** I built the client and opened `/practice` as `--device=iPhone 13` through `scripts/browse.sh`, then started the Basics lesson:
  - `matchMedia("(pointer: coarse)").matches` was `true`.
  - `html`, `body` and an `h1` computed `user-select: none`.
  - `html` and a hand card computed a transparent tap colour (`rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)`).
  - `getSelection().selectAllChildren(document.body)` selected no text (length 0).
  - On `/login`, the email and password inputs computed `user-select: text`. I clicked the email field and typed `bot3260`, and the value read back as `bot3260` with the caret at 7.
  - I did not reach the real chat panel, which needs a signed-in `/together` session and server. Instead I injected a `<div class="chat-panel">` with a message. Its text computed `user-select: text`, its tap colour came back (`rgba(51, 181, 229, 0.4)`), and its text could be selected (`"hello there friend"`).
  - Chromium has no `-webkit-touch-callout`, so the callout is covered by the unit test only.
  - A real long press and the real chat component were not exercised.

## Decisions the issue did not settle

- **The 2FA key stays selectable on a phone.** `TwoStepSettings` has no copy button, and Safari reads only the prefixed `user-select`, so an iPhone would inherit `none` and lose the only way to copy the key. I added `-webkit-user-select: all`, the one deliberate exception to "nothing but the chat". The alternatives were to leave it unselectable or to add a copy button, which is out of scope here. A person can veto this.
- **Other sheets' `-webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent` stay** in `portrait.css`, `audio.css`, `deckbuilder.css` and `inspect.css`. They are redundant but harmless, and removing them is a change the task does not need.
- **The new test is its own file**, `highlight.test.ts`, rather than a rewrite of the old #2015 test in `Zone.test.tsx`, which is about zones, not the page.
- **Plan departures:** none.

## Look twice

- Every stylesheet that sets `user-select: none` for its own element (cards, drag, deckbuilder and others) is unaffected. Any other copyable text on a phone is now unselectable, as the issue asks.
- A legal zone no longer greys on a tap either; its `data-legal` glow remains its feedback.

### Its own review

Built and checked on `claude-8`. This is a draft while its own review run, on the same subscription, reviews it adversarially and fixes what it finds (up to 3 rounds); CI runs on it meanwhile. Once that review approves it, it is marked ready and auto-merge turns on.
```
